reason: I already pay a VA to do this, and there are no reviews or case studies, so I have no proof it books calls. I'm not putting my card down on something nobody has shown results for, and the 3-day trial is too short to see a single booked call.
objection: No reviews, no case studies, no results published. How do I know it books calls and doesn't just burn through my Instagram account? And if it bills on day 4 and payments are final, I carry all the risk.
would_change_my_mind: A few real customers in my situation (small agency, cold IG DMs) showing actual booked calls, or a trial long enough (a couple of weeks) or a refund if it books me nothing.
